main_body: market stall with striped awning and wooden counter
top_band: green and cream striped awning top (rows 2-10) and tan wooden counter top (rows 26-29)
evidence: The market stall clearly shows two horizontal top surfaces in 3/4 view: the striped awning top (rows 2-10, 9px tall) with a scalloped front overhang (rows 11-12) casting shadow on the recessed stall interior (rows 13-25), and the tan counter top (rows 26-29, 4px tall) sitting above the darker brown front wooden panel (rows 30-43).

style.evidence: This is a native Beodeul stall piece sharing the exact base construction, wood grain texture, and 5-step awning/wood shading ramps as the reference cheese stall on the left.
